description:
Two gaps let a workspace-clippy failure reach CI on fz-gk4 (PR 88), where the lint job had been green on PRs 85/86/87.

1. .githooks/pre-commit runs:
     cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
   CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, lint job) runs:
     cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
   Without --workspace the hook never lints the fz-runtime crate, so unused
   bindings in runtime/src/heap/heap_test.rs passed the hook and failed CI. The
   hook's own header comment claims it 'Mirrors the CI lint job', which is what
   made the gap invisible.

   Same divergence in cargo check: hook uses --all, CI's coverage run is
   --workspace. Worth aligning both while in there.

2. There is no pre-push hook at all. core.hooksPath points at
   /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz/.githooks, which contains only pre-commit. Push is
   ungated, so a --no-verify commit or an amend that skips the hook reaches the
   remote unchecked.

Fix: make the hook literally invoke the same commands as the CI lint job
(single source of truth -- consider a script both call, so they cannot drift
again). Decide separately whether a pre-push hook is wanted; if so, keep it to
the lint job only, since the full test job takes 13-16 min.

Note for whoever picks this up: the CI *test* job is red on every recent PR
(85, 86, 87, 88) from pre-existing fixture_matrix reds, so 'CI is green' is not
currently a merge signal for that job -- only lint is. That makes the lint gap
more consequential than it looks.

## RE-VERIFIED at main 417c5b0b5 -- half fixed

Gap 1 is CLOSED. .githooks/pre-commit now runs

    cargo check --all
    cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

which matches CI's lint job exactly. (`--all` is an alias for `--workspace`, so
the cargo check divergence this ticket also noted is a non-issue.)

Gap 2 is STILL TRUE. `ls .githooks/` shows `pre-commit` and nothing else. Push
remains unguarded.

## A second, larger gap found since

The pre-commit hook is not the only place local verification diverges from CI.
CI runs `cargo test --tests` over EVERY test target; the habitual local gate is
`cargo test --lib` plus the fixture matrix, which leaves `fz2_cli` and
`aot_variadic_open` unrun. A pre-existing `fz2_cli` failure survived an entire
14-PR stack because of it, hidden behind cargo's fail-fast:

    lib fails    -> matrix never runs
    matrix fails -> fz2_cli never runs

Two of those layers were only discovered by fixing the layer above. See
fz-f98.25, which owns documenting the real gate; a pre-push hook is the
enforcement half of the same problem and should be designed with it.

## Checks

- A pre-push hook exists and runs what CI runs, or the decision not to have one
  is written down with its reasoning.
- Whatever it runs includes every test target, not lib + matrix.
- The hook's header comment describes what it actually does; the claim that it
  "mirrors the CI lint job" is what made the original gap invisible.
title: No pre-push hook: push is unguarded, and the local gate does not run what CI runs
